bluf: The Guardian World reported that Russia attacked a hospital in central Kyiv, near several western embassies. BBC News World reported that a Russian ballistic missile strike left one of Ukraine’s largest power stations barely standing, with the site under constant drone threat. Reuters and BleepingComputer reported a worldwide Microsoft 365 outage affecting Outlook, Teams and Copilot.

cyber.text: BleepingComputer reported that Check Point released emergency hotfixes for a high-severity flaw exploited to gain root privileges and establish persistence on vulnerable devices since late October.
BleepingComputer reported that a critical flaw in the Apache HTTP Server HTTP/2 module could allow an unauthenticated attacker to obtain remote code execution.

items.text: The Guardian World reported that Russia attacked a hospital in central Kyiv, close to several western embassies.
BBC News World reported that one of Ukraine’s largest power stations was barely left standing after a Russian ballistic missile strike, and was under constant drone threat.

BBC News World reported that a Russian warship was hit by a Ukrainian drone in the Gulf of Finland; the outlet said this was thought to be the first such attack on a Russian ship in an open stretch of the Baltic Sea.
A worldwide Microsoft 365 outage affected Outlook, Teams and Copilot, with users reporting connectivity problems.
